headline: Amal sees how a saved conversation becomes a summary, evidence-linked relationship insight, and deliberately scoped PDF before the real app sign-in.
overview: A live product-level walk for Scribe Quest · Web, framed around Amal Rahman's actual decision rather than a list of routes.
targetAudience: Runs client conversations that create decisions and follow-ups faster than she can document them. She needs meaning and ownership preserved, not a verbatim transcript to reread.

steps.title: The output is meaning and momentum
steps.description: The sample result shows what mattered, next steps, and people before asking Amal to trust the capture machinery.
steps.screenshotAlt: Scribe Quest example summary with next steps and people

steps.title: Capture, signal, and action stay distinct
steps.description: The product separates recording from interpretation and follow-up, making control and responsibility visible.

steps.title: A saved conversation reopens around the result
steps.description: The first embedded walkthrough follows a saved conversation into its useful summary and explicit next steps.

steps.title: Relationship claims retain their source
steps.description: The second walkthrough makes provenance part of the experience by tracing a relationship hypothesis back to a transcript quote.

steps.title: Sharing is a deliberate content decision
steps.description: The PDF walkthrough shows transcript and source excerpts as explicit inclusion choices rather than a hidden all-or-nothing export.

steps.title: The real workspace is account-protected
steps.description: The Flutter workspace reaches its genuine email and Google sign-in screen; no test account is invented for the walkthrough.

keyFeatures: Transcribe on device or in the cloud
